evidence_units.claim: Per-model reserveTokens/keepRecentTokens are resolved, validated, and tested.
Resolved settings are applied across model switching and compaction paths.
Compaction is placed before a real next model request and avoids terminal tool-result compaction.
Custom context-visible entries contribute to compaction budget and cut points.

case_actions.semantic_goal: Resolve model-specific compaction policy with fallback and safe validation.
Replay the resolved policy across all runtime compaction paths.
Place pressure checks at the next real request boundary.
Account for all context-visible session artifacts.

case_workflow.goal: Keep model-dependent compaction behavior consistent and correctly timed.
conditional_branches: If the next tool result terminates the turn, do not prepare a new assistant request.

validation_status.notes: Policy propagation aligns with the residual-budget family; timing and accounting are separate mechanisms.
